method:
Heather seed-32 integration (2026-11-02), founder-authorized: three FOUNDER LISTENING PASS takes
replace their shipping files by the 2026-10-17/18 route. Nothing is remastered or generated.

  close                (Ending)             close_3b06cf13.m4a
  part_closeWhatsOpen  (Set screens aside)  part_closeWhatsOpen_a811d003.m4a
  part_activeJob       (One active job)     part_activeJob_5b1bb959.m4a

Checks before any write (all must pass, else STOP with nothing changed):
  1. the shipping file's SHA-1 equals its PRODUCTION_SHA1.txt line AND the committed baseline
     (git HEAD 8bfd42c blob);
  2. provenance of the seed-32 raw: the 2026-11-01 credit ledger entry (voice plP9aw1rizYgjFfuvLQ7,
     eleven_multilingual_v2, the frozen settings, seed 32, the canonical manifest script verbatim,
     file SHA-1);
  3. the approved master (preexpiry_review_2026-11-01/<clip>/masters/seed32_as_shipped.m4a) is
     reproduced byte-for-byte by the frozen rule (review_pack.master, Heather's frozen median and
     voice gain, no extra gain) from that raw, and equals the bank's QA'd candidate master.
Then, per clip: the shipping file is copied (byte-identical) to REPLACED_shipping_seed30_<file> in
this folder, and the approved master is byte-copied over the shipping file under the same name.
PRODUCTION_SHA1.txt: the pre-correction list is kept here as PRE_CORRECTION_PRODUCTION_SHA1.txt and
exactly three lines change (LF kept). production.FOUNDER_FINAL is edited separately (by hand).
Usage: python -I apply.py <repo>

files.script: That’s your Circle. Take a moment before you move on.
Set screens aside. Minimise what you don’t need on your screens — nothing needs closing. Keep in view only what comes next.
One active job. One job that keeps you on your feet — sweeping, hoovering, carrying things — at a pace that feels comfortable.
